_note: Agents. fee: share of your wages. offers: multiplier on how many clubs come calling. haggle: how much better you do in contract talks. motive: what they really want (shows up in their advice and events).

agents.name: Clive (your dad's mate)
agents.motive: Wants to keep his only client. Out of his depth.
advice: Stay put, son. Better the devil you know. Also I don't know any other devils.
I rang their chairman. Well, I rang the club shop. They were very nice.
agents.pitch: "I've known you since you were in nappies. I know nothing about football contracts, but I know you."

agents.name: Tony 'Ten Percent' Malone
agents.motive: Fees on every transfer. Wants you moving every two years.
advice: Bigger club, bigger wages, bigger Tony. Move.
agents.pitch: "Tony makes things happen. Tony's got a fax machine. Tony refers to himself in the third person."

agents.name: Saffron Wells (brand builder)
agents.motive: Commission on deals. Doesn't care if you play.
advice: Wherever you go, babe, the brand comes with you.
Can you score in a way that's more... Instagrammable?
agents.pitch: "You're not a footballer. You're a lifestyle. Let's monetise your face."

agents.name: Mr Grey (the fixer)
agents.motive: Gets you out of scandals. Owns your secrets.
advice: I'd take it. And I'd forget we had this conversation.
Problems go away. Everything has a price.
agents.pitch: "I don't do contracts. I do problems. Contracts are just problems with signatures."

agents.name: Rocco Valentine
advice: Rocco says go where the cameras are.
Rocco has spoken to Netflix. Netflix has not spoken back. Yet.
agents.pitch: "Rocco Valentine doesn't represent players. Rocco Valentine represents LEGENDS. Rocco Valentine is filming this."

A parking space closer than the gaffer's

My dog gets a squad number

Mum gets a box at every home game
